name: Nasi Goreng
description: Classic Indonesian fried rice with savory kecap manis and aromatic spices.
ingredients: Fried egg and cucumber for serving
steps: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat.
Saute garlic and shallots until fragrant and golden, about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp paste and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Push aromatics to the side, crack in the eggs, and scramble until just set.
Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in kecap manis and soy sauce. Toss everything together well.
Season with salt and pepper. Stir-fry 1-2 more minutes on high heat.
Serve topped with a fried egg, sliced cucumber, and green onion.

name: Ayam Goreng
description: Juicy Indonesian fried chicken marinated in spices and deep-fried to golden perfection.
steps: Blend garlic, shallots, coriander, and turmeric into a smooth paste.
Combine chicken, spice paste, bay leaves, lemongrass, water, and salt in a pot.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until water is absorbed and chicken is coated, about 20 min.
Let chicken cool slightly so the spice coating dries a bit.
Heat oil for deep frying. Fry chicken pieces until golden and crispy, about 8-10 min.
Drain and serve with steamed rice and sambal.

name: Mie Goreng
description: Indonesian stir-fried noodles loaded with vegetables, egg, and a savory sweet sauce.
ingredients: Green onion and fried shallots to serve
steps: Cook noodles according to package, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok, saute garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add carrots and cabbage, stir-fry 2 min.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, kecap manis, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2-3 min.
Serve topped with fried shallots and green onion.

name: Soto Ayam
description: A light and fragrant Indonesian turmeric chicken soup served with rice and fresh garnishes.
ingredients: Glass noodles, hard-boiled egg, fried shallots, lime to serve
steps: Boil chicken in water with lemongrass, lime leaves, and ginger until cooked, about 30 min.
Shred chicken meat and set aside.
Blend garlic, shallots, and turmeric into a paste; saute in oil until fragrant.
Add spice paste to the broth. Simmer 15 min. Season with salt.
Soak glass noodles in hot water until soft.
Assemble: noodles in bowl, top with shredded chicken, ladle hot broth, garnish with egg, fried shallots, and lime.

name: Rendang Daging
description: Rich and dry Minang beef rendang slow-cooked in coconut milk and a complex spice paste.
steps: Blend chilies, shallots, garlic, and galangal into a spice paste.
In a large pot, combine beef, spice paste, coconut milk, water, lemongrass, and lime leaves.
Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally.
Cook for 1.5-2 hours until liquid reduces and beef is deeply colored and tender.
Increase heat at the end, stirring frequently until nearly dry and dark.
Serve with steamed rice.

name: Tempe Orek
description: Crispy sweet and spicy caramelized tempeh, a beloved Indonesian everyday side dish.
ingredients: 300 g tempeh, cut into small sticks
steps: Deep fry tempeh sticks until golden and crispy. Drain and set aside.
In a pan, saute shallots, garlic, chilies, and bay leaf until softened.
Add kecap manis, soy sauce, and palm sugar. Stir until sauce is thick.
Add fried tempeh and toss to coat evenly.
Cook 2-3 more minutes until tempeh absorbs the sauce.
Serve as a side with rice and vegetables.

name: Nasi Uduk
description: Fragrant coconut milk rice cooked with lemongrass and bay leaves, a Jakarta breakfast staple.
ingredients: Fried shallots and cucumber to serve
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Combine rice, coconut milk, water, lemongrass, bay leaves, lime leaves, and salt in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to the lowest heat, cover, and cook 20 min.
Fluff with a fork and remove aromatics.
Serve with fried shallots, sliced cucumber, and your choice of sides.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Glazed Japanese-style chicken thighs with a sticky, savory-sweet teriyaki sauce.
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onion to garnish
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a bowl.
Score chicken skin lightly.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat, place chicken skin-side down.
Cook 5-6 min until golden, flip and cook 4 more min.
Pour in teriyaki sauce and simmer, basting the chicken until sauce thickens.
Slice, drizzle remaining sauce, and garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Tom Yum Soup
description: Spicy and sour Thai prawn soup bursting with lemongrass, kaffir lime, and galangal.
steps: Bring broth to a boil with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
Add chili paste, fish sauce, and mushrooms. Simmer 5 min.
Add tomatoes and prawns, cook until prawns are pink, about 3 min.
Stir in lime juice. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro.

name: Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with tamarind, fish sauce, and crunchy peanuts.
ingredients: Bean sprouts, peanuts, lime wedge, green onion to serve
steps: Soak noodles in warm water 20 min until flexible; drain.
Mix tamarind, fish sauce, and palm sugar into a sauce.
Heat oil in wok, saute garlic, add chicken and cook through.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce, toss over high heat 2-3 min.
Add bean sprouts, toss briefly.
Serve with crushed peanuts, lime, and green onion.

name: Gado-Gado
description: Indonesian vegetable salad with hard-boiled eggs, tofu, and a rich peanut sauce.
steps: Blanch bean sprouts, cabbage, and long beans briefly in boiling water.
Slice potatoes and pan-fry tofu until golden.
Make peanut sauce: blend peanuts, garlic, chilies, tamarind, kecap manis, and enough water to a smooth pourable consistency.
Arrange all vegetables, eggs, and tofu on a platter.
Drizzle generously with warm peanut sauce.
Serve with prawn crackers on the side.

name: Beef Bulgogi
description: Korean marinated beef grilled or pan-fried to caramelized, smoky perfection.
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onion to garnish
steps: Combine soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, mirin, grated pear, garlic, and ginger into a marinade.
Toss beef and onion in the marinade. Marinate at least 30 min, preferably overnight.
Heat a grill pan or cast iron over high heat.
Cook beef in batches without overcrowding, 1-2 min per side until caramelized.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.
Serve over steamed rice with kimchi.

name: Sup Jagung
description: Creamy Indonesian sweet corn soup with egg ribbons and a comforting golden broth.
ingredients: 3 ears sweet corn, kernels cut off (or 2 cans)
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Saute garlic in a pot with a little oil until soft.
Add broth and corn kernels. Bring to a boil.
Blend half the soup for a creamier texture, then return to pot.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and simmer until slightly thickened.
Slowly drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring to create ribbons.
Season with salt, pepper, and sesame oil. Top with green onion.

name: Bakso
description: Indonesian meatball soup served with egg noodles in a clear, savory beef broth.
ingredients: Bok choy, fried shallots, soy sauce, sambal to serve
steps: Mix ground beef with tapioca flour, garlic powder, salt, and white pepper until sticky.
Form into smooth balls using wet hands.
Bring water to a gentle simmer, drop meatballs in until they float, about 5 min. Set aside.
In a separate pot, bring beef broth to a boil. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook egg noodles, drain, and portion into bowls.
Add meatballs and bok choy. Ladle hot broth over. Top with fried shallots and serve with sambal.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Homemade creamy macaroni coated in a rich, velvety cheddar cheese sauce.
steps: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni until tender, about 8 min. Drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in flour, salt, and black pepper until smooth, about 5 min.
Slowly pour in milk while constantly stirring; cook until smooth and bubbling, about 5 min.
Add cheddar and stir until melted, 2-4 min.
Fold in drained macaroni until fully coated. Serve hot.

name: Baked Chicken Wings
description: Crispy oven-baked chicken wings coated in garlic, chili, and olive oil - no frying needed.
ingredients: Salt and ground black pepper to taste
steps: Preheat oven to 190 degrees C (375 degrees F).
Combine olive oil, garlic, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a large resealable bag.
Add chicken wings, seal, and shake well to coat evenly.
Arrange wings in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake until crisp and cooked through, 30-45 min, flipping halfway.
Serve hot with your favourite dipping sauce.

name: Beef Stew
description: Hearty slow-simmered beef stew with potatoes, carrots, and a rich savory broth.
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Dust lightly in flour.
Brown beef in oil over high heat in batches. Set aside.
Saute onion and garlic in the same pot until soft.
Add tomato paste and stir 1 min.
Return beef, add broth, Worcestershire sauce, and thyme. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 45 min.
Add potatoes and carrots, cook 25-30 more min until tender.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

name: Nasi Kuning
description: Golden turmeric rice cooked in coconut milk, often served at celebrations and special occasions.
ingredients: Fried shallots and boiled egg to serve
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Combine rice, coconut milk, water, turmeric, lemongrass, bay leaves, lime leaves, and salt in a pot.
Stir gently and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to the lowest setting, cover tightly, and cook 20 min.
Fluff rice gently and remove aromatics.
Mold into a cone shape if desired, or serve flat garnished with fried shallots and boiled egg.

name: Garlic Butter Rice
description: Simple and aromatic garlic butter rice - the perfect fluffy side for any main dish.
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add garlic and saute until fragrant and lightly golden, about 2 min.
Add rice and stir to coat in the garlic butter for 1-2 min.
Pour in broth and salt. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 18 min until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Chicken Tinola
description: Filipino ginger chicken soup with green papaya and chili leaves in a clear, warming broth.
steps: Heat oil in a pot, saute garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in water and bring to a boil. Skim off any foam.
Add fish sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer over medium heat for 25 min until chicken is tender.
Add green papaya and cook 5 min until slightly tender.
Stir in chili leaves or spinach at the very end. Serve hot with rice.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
description: Sticky, glossy chicken thighs glazed in a sweet honey garlic sauce - quick and irresistible.
ingredients: Fresh thyme or rosemary to garnish
steps: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken skin-side down for 5-6 min until golden. Flip and sear 3 min.
Remove chicken. Saute garlic in the same pan 30 seconds.
Stir in honey, soy sauce, and vinegar. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the pan, coat with sauce. Transfer to oven.
Bake at 200 degrees C (390 degrees F) for 20 min, basting halfway.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve with rice or vegetables.

name: Pho Bo
description: Vietnamese beef noodle soup with a deeply aromatic star anise and cinnamon broth.
ingredients: Bean sprouts, basil, lime, chili to serve
steps: Char ginger and onion directly over an open flame or under a broiler until blackened on the outside.
Boil beef bones in water for 5 min, then discard water and rinse bones.
In a fresh pot, add bones, charred ginger and onion, star anise, cinnamon, and cloves.
Cover with 2 L water and simmer for 1.5 hours. Skim foam regularly.
Strain broth. Season with fish sauce, sugar, and salt.
Cook rice noodles according to package and drain.
Place noodles in bowls, top with raw beef slices. Ladle boiling broth over to cook the beef.
Serve with bean sprouts, fresh basil, lime wedges, and chili on the side.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Classic French soup of deeply caramelized onions in a rich beef broth, topped with melted Gruyere.
steps: Melt butter and oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat.
Add onions and sugar. Cook slowly, stirring often, for 40-50 min until deeply golden and caramelized.
Stir in flour and cook 2 min.
Add white wine and stir to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits.
Pour in beef broth and thyme. Simmer 20 min. Season with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top with baguette slices and a generous pile of Gruyere.
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbling. Serve immediately.

name: Ramen
description: Comforting Japanese ramen in a rich soy and miso broth with soft-boiled egg and pork.
ingredients: 100 g chashu pork or roasted pork belly, sliced
Corn and bamboo shoots for topping
steps: In a pot, saute garlic and ginger in sesame oil for 1 min.
Add broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Whisk in miso paste and soy sauce. Do not boil after adding miso.
Cook ramen noodles separately according to package; drain well.
Place noodles in serving bowls.
Ladle hot broth over the noodles.
Top with soft-boiled egg halved, sliced pork, nori, green onion, and corn.
Add a drizzle of sesame oil and serve immediately.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Classic Italian pasta with golden garlic, olive oil, chili flakes, and fresh parsley.
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-low heat.
Add garlic slices and cook slowly until golden but not brown, about 4 min.
Add chili flakes and stir 30 seconds.
Add drained pasta and splash in pasta water. Toss vigorously to emulsify.
Remove from heat, stir in fresh parsley.
Serve immediately with parmesan if desired.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Italian risotto loaded with earthy mushrooms and finished with butter and parmesan.
steps: Heat oil and 1 tbsp butter in a wide pot over medium heat.
Saute onion until soft, about 5 min. Add garlic and mushrooms, cook until mushrooms are golden.
Add rice and stir to coat in the oil for 2 min.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting until each addition is absorbed.
Continue for about 20-25 min until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat, stir in remaining butter and parmesan.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh thyme. Serve immediately.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh Italian salad of ripe tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, and basil drizzled with olive oil.
ingredients: Flaky sea salt and black pepper
steps: Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a large plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil.
Drizzle balsamic glaze over the top.
Season with flaky sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Juicy spiced ground beef tacos with salsa, cheese, and all your favourite toppings.
ingredients: 8 small taco shells or corn tortillas
Salsa, shredded cheese, sour cream, lettuce, lime to serve
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Saute onion until soft.
Add garlic and cook 1 min.
Add ground beef and break apart. Cook until browned, about 6-8 min.
Drain excess fat.
Add cumin, chili powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir well and cook 2 more min.
Warm taco shells or tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beef mixture and top with salsa, cheese, sour cream, lettuce, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Yukgaejang
description: Fiery Korean beef and vegetable soup with a deep red chili broth - spicy, hearty, and warming.
ingredients: 2 stalks green onion, cut into pieces
steps: Boil beef brisket in 1.5 L water for 40 min until tender. Reserve broth.
Shred beef into strips and set aside.
If using fernbrake, soak and boil until soft; if using bean sprouts, blanch briefly.
Mix gochugaru, soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic into a spice paste.
Toss shredded beef and vegetables in the spice paste.
Add reserved broth to a pot, bring to a boil, add spiced beef and vegetables.
Simmer 15 min. Slowly drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with steamed rice.

name: Laksa
description: Spicy and creamy Southeast Asian coconut curry noodle soup loaded with prawns and tofu.
ingredients: Bean sprouts, fresh mint, lime to serve
steps: Soak rice vermicelli in warm water until soft; drain.
In a pot, fry laksa paste over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 min.
Pour in broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar. Simmer 10 min.
Add prawns and cook until pink, about 3 min.
Add fried tofu and heat through.
Divide vermicelli into bowls, ladle hot laksa broth and toppings over.
Garnish with bean sprouts, fresh mint, and lime wedges.

name: Nasi Bakar
description: Grilled banana leaf-wrapped rice stuffed with spiced chicken and aromatic herbs.
ingredients: 200 g chicken, shredded and cooked with spices
steps: Mix shredded chicken with kecap manis, shallots, garlic, chilies, and coconut milk. Season with salt.
Soften banana leaves briefly over an open flame or in hot water.
Spread a portion of rice on a banana leaf, add chicken filling on top, then cover with more rice.
Fold banana leaf tightly around the rice and secure with toothpicks.
Grill on a charcoal or gas grill for 8-10 min per side until fragrant and slightly charred.
Open at the table and serve with sambal.

name: Chicken Katsu
description: Japanese crispy panko-breaded chicken cutlet served with tonkatsu sauce and shredded cabbage.
ingredients: Tonkatsu sauce, steamed rice, shredded cabbage to serve
steps: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, and panko in separate bowls.
Coat each chicken piece in flour, dip in egg, then press firmly into panko.
Heat oil in a pan to 170 degrees C (340 degrees F).
Fry chicken 4-5 min per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel. Slice into strips and serve on rice with cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

name: Sayur Asem
description: Fresh and tangy Indonesian tamarind vegetable soup - light, sour, and incredibly refreshing.
ingredients: 100 g corn on the cob, cut into pieces
100 g young jackfruit or chayote, cubed
Salt and palm sugar to taste
steps: Blend shallots, garlic, and chilies into a rough paste.
Bring water to a boil in a pot. Add spice paste, bay leaves, and galangal.
Add peanuts and corn. Simmer 10 min.
Add jackfruit or chayote, long beans, and melinjo.
Stir in tamarind paste. Season with salt and palm sugar.
Simmer 10 more min until all vegetables are tender but still have bite.
Taste and adjust sourness. Serve with steamed rice.

name: Kwetiau Goreng
description: Indonesian stir-fried flat rice noodles with egg, vegetables, and dark soy sauce.
steps: Soak kwetiau in warm water until pliable; drain well.
Heat oil in a wok over very high heat.
Saute garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Push aside, crack in eggs and scramble until half-set.
Add noodles and toss together. Add dark soy sauce, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Stir-fry everything vigorously for 2-3 min, letting noodles char slightly.
Add bean sprouts and green onion. Toss briefly. Season and serve hot.

name: Capcay
description: Indonesian-Chinese stir-fried mixed vegetables in a light savory sauce - colorful and nutritious.
ingredients: 1 tbsp oyster sauce (or vegetarian oyster sauce)
1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Saute garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add carrots and baby corn first; stir-fry 2 min.
Add broccoli, cauliflower, and cabbage. Stir-fry 2 more min.
Pour in broth, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Toss well.
Add cornstarch slurry and stir until sauce thickens.
Drizzle sesame oil, toss once more, and serve with steamed rice.

name: Beef Yakiniku
description: Japanese BBQ beef slices marinated in a sweet soy and sesame sauce, grilled at the table.
ingredients: 500 g beef short rib or ribeye, thinly sliced
Sesame seeds and green onion to garnish
Steamed rice and kimchi to serve
steps: Combine soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, ginger, and sake in a bowl.
Add beef slices and marinate for at least 20 min.
Heat a grill pan or cast iron skillet over very high heat until smoking.
Grill beef slices in a single layer for 1-2 min per side until caramelized.
Work in batches to avoid steaming the meat.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onion.
Serve immediately with steamed rice and kimchi.

name: Nasi Pecel
description: Javanese steamed vegetables over rice with a bold peanut and kaffir lime sauce.
ingredients: 100 g long beans, blanched and cut
steps: Blend peanuts, chilies, garlic, terasi, kaffir lime leaves, and palm sugar into a thick paste.
Add lime juice and warm water gradually until sauce is pourable but thick.
Season with salt. Taste and adjust heat and sweetness.
Arrange blanched vegetables on a plate of steamed rice.
Pour peanut sauce generously over the top.
Serve with prawn crackers and extra sambal on the side.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Rich and creamy Indian butter chicken in a velvety tomato and spice sauce.
ingredients: Fresh cilantro and naan to serve
steps: Mix chicken with half the spices, salt, and 1 tbsp yogurt. Marinate 30 min.
Sear chicken in butter over high heat until browned. Set aside.
In the same pan, saute onion until golden. Add garlic and ginger.
Add remaining spices and stir 1 min until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes. Simmer 15 min until thickened.
Blend sauce until smooth. Return to pan.
Add chicken and cream. Simmer 10 min.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

name: Minestrone
description: Hearty Italian vegetable and pasta soup with tomatoes, cannellini beans, and fresh herbs.
ingredients: Parmesan rind (optional) and fresh basil to serve
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Saute onion, carrots, and celery for 5 min.
Add garlic, oregano, and basil. Cook 1 min.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth. If using, add parmesan rind.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 min.
Add zucchini, beans, and pasta. Cook until pasta is tender, about 10 min.
Remove parmesan rind. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with fresh basil and grated parmesan.

name: Udon Stir-Fry
description: Thick and chewy Japanese udon noodles stir-fried with vegetables in a savory sauce.
ingredients: Green onion and sesame seeds to garnish
steps: Blanch udon noodles in hot water for 1 min to loosen; drain.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Saute garlic until fragrant.
Add carrot and cabbage, stir-fry 2 min.
Push vegetables aside, scramble eggs in the pan.
Add udon noodles, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Toss everything together.
Stir-fry 2-3 min until noodles are heated through and lightly charred.
Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.

name: Vegetable Curry
description: Warm and fragrant coconut vegetable curry with chickpeas, spinach, and tomatoes.
ingredients: Salt and lime juice to taste
Fresh cilantro and rice to serve
steps: Heat oil in a pot, add cumin seeds and let them sizzle 30 seconds.
Add onion and saute until golden, about 7 min.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min.
Add curry powder and turmeric, stir 1 min until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and cook until they break down, about 5 min.
Pour in coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer 15 min.
Stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime. Serve with rice and cilantro.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Classic Russian beef in a creamy mushroom and sour cream sauce, served over egg noodles.
ingredients: Egg noodles or rice to serve
steps: Season beef with salt and pepper. Sear in butter over high heat until browned. Set aside.
In the same pan, saute onion until soft. Add garlic and mushrooms; cook until golden.
Stir in flour and cook 1 min.
Add broth and Worcestershire sauce. Stir until smooth and bring to a simmer.
Cook 5 min until slightly thickened.
Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream and return beef to the pan.
Heat gently without boiling. Season to taste.
Serve over egg noodles or rice, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Nasi Liwet
description: Solo-style rice cooked in coconut milk and chicken broth, served with rich opor chicken.
ingredients: Fried shallots, boiled egg, and shredded chicken to serve
steps: Rinse rice until water runs clear.
Combine rice, coconut milk, chicken broth, lemongrass, bay leaves, lime leaves, salt, and sugar in a pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Once water is level with the rice, reduce heat to very low, cover tightly.
Cook 20 min. Remove from heat and rest covered 5 min.
Fluff gently. Serve with fried shallots, boiled egg, and shredded chicken.

name: Opor Ayam
description: Javanese chicken in mild and fragrant coconut milk broth with candlenuts and galangal.
ingredients: Salt and palm sugar to taste
steps: Blend candlenuts, shallots, garlic, galangal, coriander, and cumin into a smooth paste.
Saute spice paste in oil over medium heat for 3-4 min until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces and stir to coat with the spice paste.
Pour in water, add lemongrass and bay leaves. Simmer 20 min.
Add coconut milk and season with salt and palm sugar.
Simmer gently (do not boil hard) for 20 more min until chicken is fully tender.
Serve warm with steamed rice or nasi liwet.

name: Es Teler Pudding
description: A refreshing no-bake Indonesian-inspired coconut pudding with avocado and jackfruit.
steps: Combine coconut milk, water, agar-agar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan.
Heat over medium, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil.
Pour into a lightly greased mold or individual cups.
Allow to cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until set, at least 1 hour.
Cut or scoop pudding into pieces.
Serve in bowls with cubed avocado, jackfruit, condensed milk drizzle, and ice cubes.

name: Nasi Goreng Seafood
description: Indonesian fried rice loaded with prawns, squid, and fish cake in a savory sauce.
ingredients: Green onion and fried shallots to serve
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Saute garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add prawns and squid. Stir-fry 2 min until just cooked. Set aside.
Push aromatics aside, crack in eggs and scramble until half-set.
Add rice and stir-fry vigorously for 3 min, breaking up clumps.
Add kecap manis, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Toss everything well.
Return seafood and fish cake to the wok. Toss together 1 more min.
Serve topped with fried shallots and green onion.

name: Chicken Adobo
description: Filipino braised chicken in a tangy soy vinegar sauce with bay leaves and black pepper.
steps: Combine chicken with vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, and sugar in a pot.
Let marinate for at least 15 min.
Add water and bring to a boil uncovered.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 min until chicken is tender and sauce reduces.
Remove chicken and pan-fry in oil until browned and slightly crispy.
Return to the sauce and simmer 5 more min.
Serve over steamed rice with the pan sauce drizzled over.

name: Sup Buntut
description: Indonesian oxtail soup with a rich clear broth, potatoes, and aromatic spices.
ingredients: Fried shallots, celery leaves, and lime to serve
steps: Blanch oxtail in boiling water for 5 min. Discard water and rinse oxtail clean.
In a fresh pot, add oxtail and 2 L water. Bring to a boil.
Add whole shallots, garlic, ginger, cloves, star anise, and nutmeg.
Simmer uncovered for 1.5-2 hours until oxtail is very tender. Skim foam regularly.
Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 15 min until tender.
Add tomato and season generously with salt and white pepper.
Serve garnished with fried shallots, celery leaves, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Bihun Goreng
description: Indonesian stir-fried rice vermicelli with vegetables and egg in a light savory sauce.
ingredients: 200 g rice vermicelli (bihun), soaked until soft
Green onion, fried shallots, and lime to serve
steps: Soak rice vermicelli in room-temperature water for 10 min until pliable. Drain well.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Saute garlic and shallots until golden.
Add carrot and cabbage, stir-fry 2 min.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs.
Add drained vermicelli, soy sauce, kecap manis, and oyster sauce.
Toss everything together gently over high heat for 2 min.
Serve with fried shallots, green onion, and a wedge of lime.

name: Tumis Kangkung
description: Quick and fiery Indonesian stir-fried water spinach with garlic, chili, and shrimp paste.
ingredients: 400 g water spinach (kangkung), cleaned and cut
steps: Heat oil in a wok over the highest heat possible.
Add garlic and chilies, stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp paste and mash it into the oil.
Throw in kangkung all at once. Toss rapidly.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce, and sugar.
Stir-fry vigorously for 1-2 min until kangkung is wilted but still bright green.
Season with salt, plate immediately, and serve with steamed rice.

name: Beef Rawon
description: East Javanese black beef soup with a deep, rich broth colored by keluak nuts.
ingredients: Bean sprouts, salted egg, and sambal to serve
steps: Blend shallots, garlic, chilies, galangal, keluak flesh, coriander, and turmeric into a paste.
Heat oil in a pot, saute spice paste for 4-5 min until very fragrant and darkened.
Add beef and stir to coat with paste. Cook 5 min.
Add water and lemongrass. Bring to a boil.
Simmer covered for 60-75 min until beef is very tender.
Season generously with salt and a pinch of sugar.
Serve with fresh bean sprouts, salted egg, and sambal.

name: Nasi Tim
description: Soft steamed rice cooked with chicken and soy sauce, a gentle and comforting Indonesian-Chinese dish.
ingredients: 200 g chicken breast, minced or finely chopped
Green onion and fried shallots to serve
steps: Rinse rice and mix with chicken broth in a heatproof bowl.
Season minced chicken with garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Place seasoned chicken on top of the rice mixture in the bowl.
Steam over boiling water for 35-40 min until rice is soft and chicken is cooked.
Stir gently to mix chicken through the rice.
Serve topped with fried shallots and sliced green onion.

name: Karaage
description: Japanese crispy bite-sized fried chicken marinated in soy, ginger, and sake.
ingredients: 600 g chicken thighs, boneless, cut into bite-sized pieces
Lemon wedges and kewpie mayo to serve
steps: Combine soy sauce, sake, mirin, ginger, and garlic in a bowl.
Add chicken and marinate for at least 30 min, ideally 2 hours.
Coat marinated chicken pieces in potato starch, pressing to adhere.
Heat oil to 170 degrees C (340 degrees F).
Fry chicken in batches for 4-5 min until light golden. Drain.
Increase oil to 190 degrees C (374 degrees F). Fry again for 1-2 min until deeply golden and crispy.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and kewpie mayo.

name: Sop Iga
description: Indonesian beef short rib soup with vegetables in a light and fragrant clear broth.
ingredients: Fried shallots, green onion, and lime to serve
steps: Blanch ribs in boiling water 5 min. Discard water and rinse ribs.
Saute shallots, garlic, and ginger in butter until soft and lightly golden.
Add ribs and fresh water. Bring to a boil.
Add nutmeg. Simmer covered for 60-70 min until ribs are tender.
Add potatoes and carrots. Cook 15 min.
Add tomato and season with salt and white pepper.
Serve topped with fried shallots, green onion, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Mie Kuah
description: Indonesian egg noodle soup in a savory chicken broth with vegetables and wonton.
ingredients: Fried shallots and green onion to serve
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil. Add garlic and soy sauce.
Season broth with sesame oil, salt, and white pepper.
Cook egg noodles in a separate pot, drain well.
Blanch bok choy in the broth for 1 min.
Cook wontons in broth for 3-4 min until they float.
Place noodles in serving bowls. Ladle hot broth over.
Top with chicken, bok choy, wontons, fried shallots, and green onion.

name: Sate Sapi
description: Indonesian beef satay skewers marinated in sweet soy and spices, grilled over charcoal.
ingredients: 500 g beef sirloin, cut into small cubes
Peanut sauce, sliced shallots, and steamed rice to serve
steps: Combine kecap manis, soy sauce, coriander, cumin, garlic, shallots, and oil.
Toss beef cubes in the marinade. Rest at least 30 min.
Thread 4-5 cubes onto each soaked bamboo skewer.
Grill over high heat (charcoal preferred) for 2-3 min per side, basting with leftover marinade.
Continue turning until beef is charred on the outside and cooked through.
Serve with peanut sauce, sliced raw shallots, and steamed rice.

name: Beef Gyudon
description: Japanese beef rice bowl with thinly sliced beef and onion simmered in a sweet soy dashi broth.
ingredients: 400 g beef ribeye or sirloin, very thinly sliced
Pickled ginger and green onion to serve
steps: Combine dashi, soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar in a pan. Bring to a simmer.
Add sliced onion and cook 5 min until softened.
Add beef slices in a single layer. Simmer gently 3-4 min, turning once, until just cooked.
Mound hot steamed rice in bowls.
Spoon beef and onion over rice and ladle sauce generously over.
Top with a halved soft-boiled egg, pickled ginger, and green onion.

name: Chow Mein
description: Classic Chinese-American stir-fried noodles with vegetables and oyster sauce.
ingredients: 300 g chow mein noodles or thin egg noodles
150 g chicken breast or tofu, sliced
steps: Cook noodles until just tender, rinse with cold water, and drain well.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Cook chicken or tofu until done. Set aside.
Saute garlic until fragrant. Add carrot and cabbage, stir-fry 2 min.
Add noodles and toss together.
Add oyster sauce and soy sauce. Toss vigorously over high heat 2-3 min.
Return chicken or tofu. Add bean sprouts, toss 30 seconds.
Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with green onion and serve immediately.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Creamy smashed avocado on toasted sourdough with lemon, chili flakes, and poached egg.
ingredients: Flaky sea salt and black pepper
Cherry tomatoes and microgreens to garnish (optional)
steps: Toast sourdough until golden and crispy.
Halve avocado and scoop flesh into a bowl. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Mash with a fork to desired consistency - leave it slightly chunky.
Poach eggs: bring water to a gentle simmer with vinegar. Swirl water and slide in eggs. Poach 3 min.
Spread avocado generously on toast.
Top with poached egg, chili flakes, extra sea salt, and microgreens or tomatoes.

name: Coto Makassar
description: South Sulawesi beef soup in a thick, richly spiced peanut broth.
ingredients: Green onion and sambal to serve
steps: Boil beef in water with lemongrass and galangal until very tender, about 60-75 min.
Remove meat. Cut into bite-sized pieces. Reserve broth.
Blend shallots, garlic, ginger, toasted coriander, and cumin into a paste.
Saute spice paste in oil until very fragrant, about 5 min.
Add spice paste and ground peanuts to the reserved broth. Stir well.
Simmer 15 min until broth is thick and rich. Season with salt.
Add meat back in and heat through.
Serve with green onion and sambal.

name: Klepon
description: Chewy Indonesian glutinous rice balls filled with liquid palm sugar and rolled in coconut.
ingredients: 100 g palm sugar (gula merah), finely chopped
steps: Mix grated coconut with a pinch of salt. Steam for 5 min. Set aside.
Combine glutinous rice flour, pandan paste, and warm water. Knead into a soft, pliable dough.
Take a small piece of dough, flatten it, and place a small chunk of palm sugar in the center.
Seal the edges tightly and roll into a smooth ball.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Drop in klepon balls.
Cook until they float to the surface, about 3-4 min. Remove and drain.
Roll warm klepon in the steamed grated coconut until fully coated. Serve immediately.

name: Dadar Gulung
description: Indonesian green pandan crepes filled with sweet coconut and palm sugar filling.
steps: Make filling: cook grated coconut, palm sugar, pandan leaf, and water in a pan over low heat. Stir until thick and dry. Cool.
Make batter: whisk flour, eggs, coconut milk, pandan paste, and salt until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Lightly grease.
Pour a thin ladle of batter and swirl to coat the pan. Cook 1-2 min until set.
Place a spoonful of coconut filling along one edge. Fold sides in and roll tightly.
Repeat with remaining batter and filling.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Pisang Goreng
description: Crispy Indonesian fried bananas with a light batter, golden on the outside and soft inside.
ingredients: 4 ripe bananas (pisang kepok or plantain preferred)
steps: Peel bananas and slice lengthwise, or halve crosswise.
Whisk together all-purpose flour, rice flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
Add cold water gradually and mix until a smooth, slightly thick batter forms.
Heat oil in a pan to 175 degrees C (350 degrees F).
Dip banana slices in batter, letting excess drip off.
Fry in batches for 3-4 min per side until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot, optionally with a drizzle of condensed milk.

name: Kolak
description: Warm Indonesian sweet coconut broth with banana, kolang-kaling, and sweet potato.
ingredients: 200 g sweet potato, peeled and cubed
steps: Bring water, palm sugar, pandan leaves, and salt to a boil until sugar dissolves.
Add sweet potato and kolang-kaling. Cook 10 min until sweet potato is soft.
Add bananas and cook 5 more min.
Pour in coconut milk and stir gently. Do not boil after adding coconut milk.
Heat just until steaming hot.
Taste and adjust sweetness. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Decadent warm chocolate cake with a gooey molten center, served with vanilla ice cream.
ingredients: Butter and cocoa powder to grease ramekins
steps: Preheat oven to 200 degrees C (390 degrees F). Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a bowl over simmering water. Stir until smooth. Cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, and sugar together until thick and pale, about 3 min.
Fold chocolate mixture into the egg mixture.
Sift in flour and salt. Fold gently until just combined.
Divide batter among ramekins. Bake 10-12 min until edges are set but center still jiggles.
Rest 1 min. Run a knife around the edge, invert onto plates. Serve immediately with ice cream.

name: Creme Brulee
description: Classic French custard with a perfectly caramelized burnt sugar crust on top.
steps: Preheat oven to 160 degrees C (320 degrees F).
Heat cream with vanilla until just simmering. Remove from heat.
Whisk egg yolks and sugar until pale. Slowly pour hot cream into yolks while whisking.
Strain mixture through a fine sieve.
Pour into 4 ramekins. Place in a deep baking tray. Fill tray with boiling water halfway up the ramekins.
Bake 40-45 min until custard is just set with a slight wobble in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle 1 tbsp sugar on each. Brulee with a kitchen torch until caramelized.

name: Onde-Onde
description: Crispy sesame-coated Indonesian glutinous rice balls filled with sweet mung bean paste.
ingredients: Filling: 150 g split mung beans, soaked
steps: Make filling: steam soaked mung beans until soft. Mash with sugar and vanilla. Cool and roll into small balls.
Mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, and warm water into a smooth dough.
Flatten a piece of dough, place a mung bean ball in the center, seal and roll smooth.
Roll balls in sesame seeds, pressing gently so they stick.
Deep fry in oil at 160 degrees C (320 degrees F), gently pressing balls with a ladle so they expand evenly.
Fry 6-8 min until golden and crispy, turning occasionally.
Drain and serve warm.

name: Tiramisu
description: Classic Italian no-bake dessert with espresso-soaked ladyfingers and creamy mascarpone.
steps: Beat egg yolks and sugar until pale and thick. Fold in mascarpone until smooth.
In a separate bowl, beat egg whites with a pinch of salt to stiff peaks.
Gently fold egg whites into the mascarpone mixture in 3 batches.
Mix espresso and liqueur in a shallow bowl.
Quickly dip ladyfingers one by one in the coffee mixture and layer in a dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over the biscuits. Add another layer of dipped biscuits.
Spread remaining cream on top. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Dust generously with cocoa powder before serving.
